Architecture & Features

Built with Cutting-Edge Standards

From native V8 execution to 8-language localization and Bot API 10.3+ button styling.

⚡

Native Telegram Serverless

Runs directly inside Telegram's V8 edge environment (`tgcloud`). No servers, no cold starts, no external hosting bills.

🌐

8-Language i18n Engine

Full translations for EN, RU, HI, ZH, ES, AR, FR, and DE. Users can switch via /lang with persistent SQLite settings.

🎨

Bot API 10.3+ Styling

Supports colored button styles (success, primary, danger) and rich <blockquote expandable> SMS inboxes.

📥

Real-Time SMS Inboxes

Instant online verification message retrieval. Easily read OTPs for WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, Discord, and TikTok.

💾

Relational SQLite State

Powered by sdk/db query builder. Tracks language choices, search histories, and analytics without foreign key overhead.

📱

Co-Hosted Mini App

This responsive landing page is co-hosted at https://app<id>.tgcloud.ai/ and opens natively inside the Telegram client.

Commands Reference

Quick Bot Commands

Send these commands directly to @EliteTempnumBot in Telegram.

/start

Launches the bot, checks channel membership, and opens main interactive menu.

/number

Immediately tests and returns an active virtual phone number from the pool.

/countries

Opens the paginated global country catalog to pick specific regions.

/lang [code]

Switches language preference (e.g. /lang ru, /lang hi, /lang en) with persistent SQLite settings.

/help

Displays detailed usage manual, button explanations, and safety tips.

/about

Shows software version, Telegram Serverless V8 runtime, and credits.
